column1: # Findings from check-contrast.js that have been read.
# NOT a list of things that are fine. It is a list of things looked at and
# deliberately left, which is a different claim. Fix one and delete its line.
# The key is the colour pair, not the words: slug + fill + background. A label
# can be reworded without un-reviewing the finding, but a new colour, or the
# same colour landing on a new background, is reported.
# Two kinds are recorded here, and they are not equally acceptable:
#   LIFTED   a token colour sitting on a mark. These are the residue of the
#            brief.css ink lift -- 599 such sites were repaired with .on-mark
#            and figure-scoped pins; these are what is left. They are a TODO,
#            not a decision. Several are a label colliding with a mark rather
#            than drawn on one, which wants a layout fix, not a colour.
#   DIM      a colour dim against its own background, as authored. Pre-existing,
#            and mostly a chapter's own scale with no dark counterpart.
